label: Contrapunctus 10
title: The Art of Fugue, Contrapunctus 10, double fugue at the tenth

sections.label: Episode 1
sections.summary: Soprano: a figure from the subject (2 times), in a sequence rising by a fourth every bar. Tenor: a figure from the subject (2 times), in a sequence rising by a fourth every bar. Bass: a figure from the subject (3 times), in a sequence rising by a step every bar.
sections.leads: From A minor to D minor

sections.label: Stretto: Subject in D minor (Alto); Subject in D minor, inverted (Tenor)
Episode 2
sections.summary: Soprano: a figure from the subject. Alto: a figure from the subject, inverted (2 times). Tenor: a figure from the subject and a figure from the subject, inverted. Bass: a figure from the subject, inverted (3 times), in a sequence falling by a step every bar.
sections.leads: Between two statements in D minor

sections.label: Link
sections.summary: Free counterpoint: nothing here is traced to the themes. Returns in Episode 5 (bars 56–65). Returns in Episode 6 (bars 70–74).
sections.leads: Between two statements in D minor

sections.label: Episode 3
sections.summary: Soprano: a figure from the subject. Alto: free counterpoint, in a sequence falling by a step every bar. Bass: a figure from subject 2, inverted and a figure from the subject, inverted, in a sequence falling by a step every bar.
sections.leads: Between two statements in D minor

sections.label: Combination: Subject 2 (Alto); Subject in D minor (Tenor)
Episode 4
sections.summary: Soprano: a figure from the subject (2 times), in a sequence rising by a step every half bar. Alto: a figure from the subject, inverted (2 times), in a sequence falling by a step every bar. Tenor: a figure from the subject, inverted (2 times). Bass: free counterpoint, in a sequence falling by a step every bar.
sections.leads: From D minor to A minor

sections.label: Combination: Subject 2 (Bass); Subject in A minor (Alto)
Episode 5
sections.summary: Reworks Link (bar 30) in part, with the soprano's line in the bass, the tenor's line in the soprano, the lines moved by different intervals (invertible counterpoint at the twelfth). Soprano: a figure from the subject (2 times) and a figure from the subject, inverted. Alto: a figure from the subject (2 times) and a figure from the subject, inverted. Tenor: free counterpoint. Bass: a figure from the subject, in a sequence falling by a step every bar.
sections.leads: From A minor to D minor

sections.label: Combination: Subject 2 (Tenor); Subject in D minor (Soprano)
Episode 6
sections.summary: Reworks Link (bar 30) in part, with the soprano's line in the alto, at the same pitch level. Soprano: a figure from the subject (4 times), in a sequence rising by a step every two bars. Alto: a figure from the subject (3 times) and a figure from subject 2, inverted, in a sequence rising by a step every two bars. Tenor: a figure from subject 2, inverted (2 times) and a figure from the subject, in a sequence rising by a step every two bars. Bass: a figure from the subject (2 times), in a sequence rising by a step every two bars.
sections.leads: From D minor to F major

sections.label: Combination: Subject 2 (Soprano); Subject 2 (Alto); Subject in F major, rhythm varied (Bass)
Episode 7
sections.summary: Soprano: free counterpoint. Alto: free counterpoint. Tenor: a figure from the subject.
sections.leads: From F major to D minor

sections.label: Combination: Subject 2 (Bass); Subject in D minor (Alto); Subject in D minor, rhythm varied (Soprano)
Episode 8
sections.summary: Soprano: a figure from the subject (3 times), in a sequence falling by a step every bar. Alto: a figure from the subject, inverted (4 times) and a figure from the subject, in a sequence falling by a step every bar. Tenor: a figure from the subject, inverted (2 times) and a figure from the subject, in a sequence falling by a third every bar. Bass: free counterpoint, in a sequence falling by a third every bar.
sections.leads: From D minor to B♭ major

sections.label: Combination: Subject 2, rhythm varied (Soprano); Subject in B♭ major (Tenor); Subject in B♭ major (Bass)
Episode 9
sections.summary: Soprano: a figure from the subject, inverted (2 times) and a figure from the subject. Alto: a figure from the subject and a figure from the subject, inverted. Tenor: a figure from the subject, inverted (3 times) and a figure from the subject.
sections.leads: From B♭ major to D minor; perfect cadence in G minor at bar 111

sections.label: Combination: Subject 2 (Bass); Subject in D minor (Alto); Subject in F major (Tenor)
